alibaba/qwen3.8-27b.reason: Vercel AI Gateway lists Alibaba's Qwen3.8 27B open-weight dense vision-language model (Aug 2026, 262K context); its 0.06/2.2 rate differs from the model's median but it is the same checkpoint.

callstack/apex.reason: Callstack's own coding LLM built on Gemma 4 for React Native/Next.js work (per their announcement); a real new first-party model not yet in the index.

deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-ultraf.reason: Vercel's changelog states Ultrafast serves the October 17, 2026 update of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash via Fireworks' accelerated endpoint; same checkpoint as deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017, priced at a speed-tier premium (2.4/9.6).

elevenlabs/eleven-realtime-v1-max.reason: ElevenLabs' Eleven Realtime v1 Max, the larger speech-to-speech voice-agent model released 2026-10-20 (per ElevenLabs/Vercel listings); the index has ElevenLabs speech and transcription models but no Realtime entry.

elevenlabs/eleven-realtime-v1-mini.reason: ElevenLabs' Eleven Realtime v1 Mini, the default speech-to-speech voice-agent model released 2026-10-20 (per ElevenLabs/Vercel listings); the index has ElevenLabs speech and transcription models but no Realtime entry.

humansand/ampersand-v0.1.reason: humans&'s first model, post-trained from Z.ai's GLM 5.3 (744B) and released 2026-10-20; a real new model, but a post-train of GLM is not zhipu/glm-5.3 itself and the index has no humans& entry.

liquid/d1-ultra.reason: Liquid AI's d1-ultra (released 2026-10-15), its most capable multimodal decision model; it is a larger sibling of liquid/d1 and the index has no d1-ultra entry, only liquid/d1.

meta/muse-spark-1.2-contributor.reason: Vercel's own docs: Contributor serves the same weights and 1M context as Muse Spark 1.2, only the data-use arrangement differs; still meta/muse-spark-1.2 at the 0.1/0.2 contributor rate.

meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor.reason: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor is the same Muse Spark 1.3 weights under Meta's discounted contributor-mode pricing (0.1/0.2, in exchange for Meta training on request content); still meta/muse-spark-1.3.

nace-ai/drex-max-finance.reason: Nace.AI's Drex Max Finance (released 2026-11-01 per Respan/Nace docs), the finance variant of the 27B multimodal Drex Max decision model; the index has only drex-v1.5 and drex-v2.0 from the separate Drex decision line.

nace-ai/drex-max-v1.1.reason: Nace.AI's Drex Max v1.1 (served as drex-max, released 2026-10-28 per BenchLM), the frontier multimodal decision model; the index has only drex-v1.5/drex-v2.0, which are the separate Drex decision line, so defer.

xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro-ultraspeed.reason: MiMo V2.6 Pro UltraSpeed is Xiaomi's fast-serving tier of the same 1T MiMo-V2.6-Pro checkpoint (same quality, up to 20x output speed); still xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro at the 4.35/8.7 speed-tier price.
